description:
The first desktop app to run and train AI models locally.

Unsloth Desktop is the first desktop app to run and train AI models locally, with research, export and deployment from the same open-source app on Windows, macOS and Linux. Run and train LLMs and diffusion models including Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, Qwen3.8 and DeepSeek-V4 Flash 0731, with self-healing tool calling, sandboxed code execution, private web search, Deep Research, RAG, MCP and an OpenAI-compatible API.
Inkling 2 Mini runs up to 1.9x faster on all GPUs for decoding + RTX Spark improvements. Also new: faster GRPO and AsyncGRPO training, Qwen-Image-Flash and FastWan, a Knowledge page in Settings and audio, subtitle and image translation.
Highlights
- Inkling 2 Mini on 8 to 12 GB GPUs up to 1.9x faster decoding guide
- Multi-GPU diffusion LoRA training about 2x the samples per second on two GPUs
- Qwen-Image-Flash + FastWan 4-step images about 14x faster than Qwen-Image, 3-step video up to 3x faster
- GRPO improvements AsyncGRPO 40% less time + 2x faster GRPO rollouts on Strix Halo**
- Better compaction Gracefully closes thinking and continues in the next message
- First-run welcome to set your name, theme and wallpaper
- Translate audio, subtitles and images with the translation drawn over the image
Inkling 2 Mini
- On 8 GB and 12 GB GPUs, Auto now puts more of Inkling 2 Mini on the GPU, for up to 1.19x faster replies.
- When every expert fits on your GPUs, Inkling 2 processes prompts up to 1.9x faster.
- Speculative decoding for Inkling 2 now drafts 2 tokens by default, 1.15x to 1.19x faster than no draft model.
- Inkling 2 no longer runs out of memory mid-prompt on a load that started fine, and an out-of-memory reload now uses a smaller context.
- On Windows PCs with an integrated NVIDIA GPU, Inkling 2 Mini no longer loads mostly on the CPU.
- Better Inkling 2 support on RTX Spark N1X machines
Training
- AsyncGRPO with fast_inference=True takes 29 to 40% less time per step, by passing the adapter to vLLM in memory instead of through files.
- AsyncGRPO now trains LoRA on Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6 and Qwen3-Next with tree packing (TRL 1.17 or newer).
- GRPO rollouts without vLLM take up to 40% less time per step with padded batches on L4.
- On AMD Strix Halo, GRPO rollouts run 2x faster on Linux and Windows.
- A LoRA adapter on lm_head now trains in SFT and GRPO instead of getting no gradient.
- With TRL 1.15 or newer, SFT evaluate() with compute_metrics and trainer.predict() no longer crash.
- MoE training with gradient checkpointing no longer leaks up to 14 GiB.
- Gemma 4 tool-calling datasets with JSON-string arguments now train in Gemma 4's own call format.
Images + video
- Run nvidia/Qwen-Image-Flash, NVIDIA's 4-step Qwen-Image, about 14x faster per image than Qwen-Image at its defaults.
- Run FastWan2.2-TI2V-5B-FullAttn and FastWan2.1-T2V-1.3B in 3 steps, 2.5x to 3x and 5.9x faster end to end than their base models.
- Every Wan video model now shows live previews while it renders.
- With two NVIDIA GPUs, guidance-free video renders split each step across both cards, 1.2x to 1.33x faster on 2x T4.
- On Linux, diffusion LoRA training can use several identical NVIDIA GPUs with num_gpus, about 2x the samples per second on two T4s.
- On RTX 40-series, L4 and newer NVIDIA GPUs, Auto precision trains diffusion LoRAs on an fp8 base, 1.27x to 1.8x faster on Z-Image.
- FLUX.2 klein 9B-KV edits run 1.47x to 2.23x faster on their own pipeline.
- Z-Image base no longer renders black or as a cyan grid on Macs.
Chat
- Settings > Knowledge lets you manage knowledge bases and see how much of each one is embedded.
- Each project can now keep its own set of MCP servers.
- Local thinking models no longer end a reply with only a thought and no answer when thinking fills the context.
- Chats with connected models keep generating when your phone sleeps or the tab is in the background.
- Auto-compact at in Settings > Connections is now a percent of each model's context window and can be set per model.
- On Ollama and Custom connections, /compact works again and Max Tokens can reach the model's context window.
- Deep Research now reads the page linked in your question and cites it.
- LFM2.5 tool calls now run instead of showing up as text.
Desktop + Translate
- New accounts get a short welcome to set a name, avatar, theme and wallpaper.
- Translate now takes audio, SRT and VTT subtitle and video files, and Show on image draws the translation over a picture.
- One Windows installer now picks x64 or ARM64 for you, and the single-architecture installers warn on the wrong processor.
- Chat only installs on Macs now include MLX, so MLX models can chat.
